name: ID 3740
title: Entrepreneurship and Innovation in Industrial Design
description: Fostering skills for creative thinking, market research. Finding opportunities and demand. Connecting with end users and main stakeholders. Brainstorming on innovation in industrial design and comparative advantages. Idea generation, idea selection and development of concepts and prototypes. Pitching ideas, funding, developing a business plan and business expansion. Patent searching and writing, creation of a Bill of Materials (BOM), brand creation.
requirement_description: ID 3710. Not open for credit to students who have passed ENGR 3195 when offered as "Innovation and Entrepreneurship."
